description: Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over an existing command and control channel. Stolen data is encoded into the normal communications channel using the same protocol as command and control communications.

log_tail.pattern: In the S10 multi-stage chain context, exfiltration is the final stage. Log-tail detectors for S1/S3/S4 earlier in the chain provide corroborating log-tail evidence that precedes the Falco exfiltration alert.

falco.trigger_condition: Outbound connect() syscall from sentinelmesh-webapp or sentinelmesh-authservice to a destination IP not in the sentinelmesh_self_ips or sentinelmesh_expected_egress macros — catches any unexpected external connection attempt regardless of protocol

mitigation: Implement strict egress filtering on all container networks — only allow outbound connections to explicitly allowlisted IPs and ports. Use a network policy (e.g., Docker network isolation, Kubernetes NetworkPolicy) to block unexpected outbound traffic. Deploy a proxy or SSRF-prevention layer for any container that legitimately needs outbound access. Monitor for and alert on outbound connections to non-allowlisted destinations.
